description: Polyphonic oscillator carrying the five Surge generators — classic, sine, two FM models and sample-and-hold noise — each with seven parameters and a CV jack for every one.

params.text: Scales both outputs, from silence to unity gain.
Picks the generator: Classic for saw, square and sub oscillator, Sine, FM2, FM3 or Noise; the seven parameter knobs change meaning with the choice.
Sets the base pitch as a MIDI note from 1 to 127, with 60 giving middle C at 261.63Hz.
Switches the pitch between a note name with the knob snapped to whole semitones, and a frequency in Hz with the knob free between them.
Sets Shape with the Classic and Sine generators, M1 Amount with FM2 and FM3, and Correlation with Noise.
Sets Width with Classic, Feedback with Sine, M1 Ratio with FM2 and FM3, and Width with Noise.
Sets Sub Osc Width with Classic, FM Behaviour with Sine, M2 Amount with FM2 and FM3, and Low Cut with Noise.
Sets Main to Sub Mix with Classic, Low Cut with Sine, M2 Ratio with FM2 and FM3, and High Cut with Noise.
Sets Sync with Classic and Noise, High Cut with Sine, M1/2 Offset with FM2, and M3 Amount with FM3.
Sets Unison Detune with Classic, Sine and Noise, M1/2 Phase with FM2, and M3 Frequency with FM3.
Sets Unison Voices with Classic, Sine and Noise, 1 to 16, and Feedback with FM2 and FM3.
Nothing in the module reads this switch; whichever generator is picked, the parameter it belongs to is not one that can be switched off.
Turns on the Low Cut filter of the Noise generator; with the other generators it does nothing.
Turns on the High Cut filter of the Noise generator and the Low Cut filter of the Sine generator; with the other generators it does nothing.
Turns on the High Cut filter of the Sine generator; with the other generators it does nothing.
Nothing in the module reads this switch; whichever generator is picked, the parameter it belongs to has no wider range to extend into.
Widens the range of Feedback on the Sine generator from 100% out to 400%; with the other generators it does nothing.
Widens the range of M1/2 Offset on the FM2 generator from 10Hz out to 1000Hz; with the other generators it does nothing.
Widens the range of Unison Detune from 100 cents out to 1200 cents on the Classic, Sine and Noise generators; with FM2 and FM3 it does nothing.
Widens the range of Feedback on the FM2 and FM3 generators from 100% out to 400%; with the other generators it does nothing.

inputs.text: Sets the pitch, one volt per octave added to the Pitch knob; the number of channels here sets the polyphony.
Modulates Shape, M1 Amount or Correlation depending on the generator, adding a tenth of that parameter's full range per volt.
Modulates Width, Feedback or M1 Ratio depending on the generator, adding a tenth of that parameter's full range per volt.
Modulates Sub Osc Width, FM Behaviour, M2 Amount or Low Cut depending on the generator, adding a tenth of that parameter's full range per volt.
Modulates Main to Sub Mix, Low Cut, M2 Ratio or High Cut depending on the generator, adding a tenth of that parameter's full range per volt.
Modulates Sync, High Cut, M1/2 Offset or M3 Amount depending on the generator, adding a tenth of that parameter's full range per volt.
Modulates Unison Detune, M1/2 Phase or M3 Frequency depending on the generator, adding a tenth of that parameter's full range per volt.
Modulates Feedback with FM2 and FM3, adding a tenth of its full range per volt; with the other generators it moves Unison Voices without restarting them, though the manual says this jack is ignored.

outputs.text: The left output; with the right output unpatched this one carries an even mix of the two channels.

notes: the oscillator runs in blocks of 32 samples, so it reads its CV inputs once per block and cannot be used for audio-rate FM from another module.
this module is deprecated and hidden in the module browser; the Surge XT plugin replaces it, and both plugins can be used in one patch.
menu: Preset — seven factory settings, one per generator: Init_Classic, Init_Saw, Init_Square, Init_Sine, Init_FM2, Init_FM3 and Init_Noise.
Skins — a submenu of four colour schemes, listed by file name as Classic.xml, Miami.xml, NewYork.xml and Night.xml; picking one repaints every Surge module in the rack.
